synthesis.headline: Management dropped key operational promises, while financial results show steady revenue growth and strong cash conversion.

points.text: Management dropped previous targets on quick commerce market position and FMCG beverage capacity after initial mentions.
Gigafactory and battery capacity expansions remain unverifiable due to a lack of reported figures to check against.
Annual revenue steadily increased to 1055780.0 crore by Mar 2026, accompanied by an annual PAT of 95754.0 crore.
Cash from operations remained robust at 192113.0 crore for Mar 2026, supporting a conservative debt-to-equity ratio of 0.43.

bull.text: Annual revenue climbed to 1055780.0 crore in Mar 2026 from 962820.0 crore in Mar 2025.
Cash from operations grew to 192113.0 crore in Mar 2026, demonstrating strong operational cash generation.

bear.text: Multiple strategic targets including quick commerce and beverage capacity were dropped entirely from recent calls.
New energy, solar, and digital services targets remain completely unverifiable without reported execution metrics.
